title: Questions to ask the interviewer
intro: When they ask "Do you have any questions?", always ask one or two thoughtful questions about the role and the team.
introNative: जब वे पूछें "Do you have any questions?", तो role और team के बारे में हमेशा एक-दो सोचे-समझे सवाल पूछिए।

phrases.text: What does success look like in this role in the first six months?
phrases.native: इस role में पहले छह महीनों में success का मतलब क्या होगा?
phrases.note: Shows you're already thinking about doing well.

phrases.text: How is the team structured, and who would I report to?
phrases.native: Team का structure कैसा है, और मेरी reporting किसको होगी?
phrases.note: "Report to" means who your manager would be.

phrases.text: Which tech stack is the team using for new projects?
phrases.native: नए projects के लिए team कौन सा tech stack use कर रही है?
phrases.note: A technical question shows real interest in the work.

phrases.text: What's the biggest challenge the team is facing right now?
phrases.native: इस वक्त team के सामने सबसे बड़ा challenge क्या है?
phrases.note: The answer helps you show how you could help.

phrases.text: What are the next steps in the interview process?
phrases.native: Interview process में आगे के steps क्या हैं?
phrases.note: A polite way to ask when you'll hear back.

steps.prompt: At the end, the interviewer asks: "Do you have any questions for us?" Which answer is best?
steps.promptNative: आखिर में interviewer पूछते हैं: "क्या आपके पास हमारे लिए कोई सवाल है?" कौन सा जवाब सबसे अच्छा है?
options: No, nothing. You explained everything.
What does success look like in this role in the first six months?
How many leaves will I get?
steps.answer: What does success look like in this role in the first six months?
steps.explanation: Ask about the role; "no questions" or asking only about leave can suggest low interest.
steps.explanationNative: Role के बारे में पूछिए; "no questions" कहना या सिर्फ़ leave के बारे में पूछना कम interest दिखा सकता है।

steps.promptNative: Team का structure कैसा है, और मेरी reporting किसको होगी?
steps.answer: How is the team structured, and who would I report to?

steps.audioText: Which tech stack is the team using for new projects?
options: Which tech stack was the team using for old projects?
Which tech stack is the team using for new projects?
Which test stack is the team using for new projects?
steps.answer: Which tech stack is the team using for new projects?

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: I have one doubt regarding the role.
options: I have one doubt regarding the role.
I have a question about the role.
I have a doubt regarding the role.
I am having one doubt about the role.
steps.answer: I have a question about the role.
steps.explanation: To ask something, say "question"; in international English, "doubt" means you don't believe something.
steps.explanationNative: कुछ पूछना हो तो "question" कहिए; international English में "doubt" का मतलब होता है कि आपको किसी बात पर यकीन नहीं है।

steps.prompt: You want to know when you'll hear back. Which question is best?
steps.promptNative: आप जानना चाहते हैं कि आपको जवाब कब तक मिलेगा। कौन सा सवाल सबसे अच्छा है?
options: When will you tell the result?
I am selected or not?
What are the next steps in the interview process?
steps.answer: What are the next steps in the interview process?
steps.explanation: Ask about the process politely; don't push for an instant result.
steps.explanationNative: Process के बारे में politely पूछिए; तुरंत result के लिए ज़ोर मत डालिए।

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: What all technologies you are using in this project?
options: What all technologies you are using in this project?
Which technologies are you using on this project?
What all technologies are you using in this project?
Which all technologies you are using in this project?
steps.answer: Which technologies are you using on this project?
steps.explanation: In a question, put the verb before the subject ("are you using"), and drop "all" after "what".
steps.explanationNative: सवाल में verb को subject से पहले रखिए ("are you using"), और "what" के बाद "all" हटा दीजिए।

steps.promptNative: इस वक्त team के सामने सबसे बड़ा challenge क्या है?
steps.answer: What's the biggest challenge the team is facing right now?

steps.audioText: What are the next steps in the interview process?
options: What were the last steps in the interview process?
What are the next steps in the induction process?
What are the next steps in the interview process?
steps.answer: What are the next steps in the interview process?

steps.prompt: Imagine your next real interview is ending. Out loud, ask the interviewer 3–4 questions that matter to you: about the role, the team, and the next steps.
steps.promptNative: सोचिए कि आपका अगला असली interview खत्म होने वाला है। Interviewer से बोलकर 3–4 ऐसे सवाल पूछिए जो आपके लिए मायने रखते हैं: role, team और next steps के बारे में।
